snippet.title: SECT0R: Cyber Crash V2.0.1 SAGE Trailer
snippet.description:
====================================
Omniverse Staff Team
@External VR: Owner of Omniverse

Arzue aka Gemforcegold06: 
Co owner of Omniverse/Beta tester
===================================
From SECT0R: Team we give you a SECT0R Game
Inspired off of Persona and Trails of Cold Steal. 
Follow Genesis and her friends in a new journey 
following her father's (The Omen) Footsteps.
In the Small town of Ironwood. 

Music is from: Limbus Company

Play the game Now!
https://gamejolt.com/games/Cyber-Crash/1045368

Sage 2026 Booth:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sect0r-cyber-crash-episode-one-the-cyber-hour.3093/
===================================
Intro by Darkhunter6243
